validationNotes: Start/post-verification actual nameKey counts9353/9356. Baseline8cfff7cd, clean tree/staging and no running prior tests. All9353 existing definitions, IDs, catalogue/details/aliases, image references and pins unchanged; no save-format change.

Three whole Cross Gear faces/stats/mana/current limits and four exact print images verified. Quake has one exact reprint, no additional battle name; Rifle and Kurt single-print official searches/product lists verified.

Quake grants Slayer only to its live crossed host. Multiple gears stack with printed Slayer via native count. Battle against actual larger Gradion destroys it even after the host dies; gear remains independent. Recrossing, source/host suppression, sealed source/host and real Genmu interactions pass.

Rifle provides independently selectable tap-ability actions by physical gear reference; multiple Rifles never become a single multi-destruction activation. A host retains its own printed tap ability as a separate action. Both use the existing tap/Target resolution and AI valuation. The Rifle choice never inherits a hosts separate mana payment requirement.

Rifle obeys attack phase, summoning sickness, haste, tapped/no-attack state, current enemy power, target protection and live attachment. Activating does not attack or break shields. Already activated ability survives gear departure; actual native drawing ability remains separate. Distinct action IDs and pending target choices survive encrypted online storage.

Kurt uses native execution for optional G-Zero from hand only when an own real creature exists. Normal paid generation remains available. With no mana/light card free generation works; subsequent crossing still requires ordinary Light payment. Printed +500 power stacks externally and survives an ignored host, but ends immediately on gear suppression/recrossing.

All three gears follow actual Super Paladin evolution while conserving independent physical IDs. New legal40-card game ends, conserves80 physical cards and resumes from JSON. 38 distinct focused cases and187 related regressions pass,total225; check/audit/target9500/nameKey/invariants pass.

Initial8 focused failures were fixture errors: absent attack uses undefined rather than null, no-attack grant was incorrectly scalar, Blaze Claw is not a haste creature, and online actions intentionally expose action IDs rather than internal gear metadata. Corrected fixtures use native grant shape, actual Peecap and public action IDs; all8 pass without implementation changes.

Giga Stand not registered: original and newer official full faces, both images and exact QA35021 reviewed. Simultaneous destruction can return an actual Aqua Soldier into an initially empty hand and spend it for Giga; new wording discards first, so existing return-first replacement is insufficient. Full simultaneous replacement/payment path must be verified before support is counted.
Historical interrupted/unconfirmed whole npm test, individual/long/reprint/user deferrals preserved. No repeated long whole group, push/publication/Netlify update.
